thesis: AMPH is extended after an earnings-driven run, and the market regime is risk-off with QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages. Price 29.38 sits above the 6-analyst mean target of 24.5, RSI is 70.8, and the 11-06 bar rejected at the 52-week high of 31.0 (close 28.49). Cash conversion is weak (FCF 9.2M against 37.8M quarterly net income) and net debt is material. Short interest of 22.1% of float adds two-way volatility. The news feed is down, so analyst actions, guidance and M&A are unchecked. Reward/risk of about 1.75 is modest for a name that needs a pullback to be a sensible entry, and chasing here is poor timing.
